AGENT-MESSAGE-SUBMIT U16. On a full disk one os.write returned a short count, and the next row was spliced onto the partial row (shared log line 5092).

Writer: record() now appends under an exclusive flock. It terminates an unterminated tail first, writes the row in a loop, and truncates back to the row's start on any failure, fsync included. True means a whole row; False means none.

Readers: log_rows() returns rows, bad lines by absolute offset with the row heads inside each, and an unterminated tail, which is not counted. deferred_index reports bad lines, --redeliver warns about them, and the new --check-log lists them.

Tests are in the stacked PR test/msg-u16-log-rows. Evidence: coordination machine-docs/reports/agent-message-submit/u16/.

title.text: U16: never leave a message-log row partial; readers skip and count bad lines
